# Hopf Frame Compilation

> Exact and Fault-Tolerant Compilation of Hopf Differential Frames, by Ruge Lin.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation

## Start by task

- Continuing research: fetch current main, then read [WORKSPACE](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/WORKSPACE.md) and its current proof-home links. Historical session prompts do not override that checkpoint.
- Understanding the result: [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/README.md) gives the target and selected A–D claims; [REVIEW](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/REVIEW.md) explains their mechanisms.
- Checking a theorem: [PUBLICATION_SCOPE](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/manuscript/PUBLICATION_SCOPE.md) owns selected statements and literal reservations; [docs/README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/docs/README.md) maps proof dependencies.
- Checking the current frontier: [OPEN_PROBLEM](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/docs/OPEN_PROBLEM.md) owns general resource bounds, their matching intervals and scoped lower bounds.
- Finding a construction or failed approach: [research/README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/research/README.md) is the complete topic catalogue. Detailed proofs and historical outcomes stay in their individual homes.
- Reproducing evidence: [VERIFICATION](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/docs/VERIFICATION.md) routes to tests and receipts; [the finite-evidence catalogue](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/docs/reference/VERIFICATION_CATALOGUE.md) records their exact scopes.
- Checking attribution: [SOURCE_MAP](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/docs/SOURCE_MAP.md), [RELATED_WORK](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/docs/RELATED_WORK.md) and machine-readable provenance distinguish imported premises from local contributions.

## Scientific contract

State preparation fixes one column; this project compiles a prescribed complete Hopf frame, including coordinate-frame columns. The phase-dressed complex magnitude target is a real frame followed by supplied leaf phases, not arbitrary complex-unitary synthesis.

The full initialized-isometry norm includes every logical input, arbitrary dirty work entangled with references, literal phases and clean leakage. Use the actual adjoint. Earlier approximation error is carried through later unitaries; approximate work is not silently reset to clean. Exact-return promises are construction-specific. Every source preparation, query, control, inverse, precision requirement and simultaneous workspace pool is charged.

The exact model uses arbitrary one-qubit gates and CNOTs. The coherent Clifford+T model has no measurements, reset, postselection, QRAM, supplied catalysts or free data-loading/evaluation oracles. Certified classical preprocessing is separate from quantum costs. T-depth allows arbitrary Clifford interlayers and is distinct from total physical depth; Clifford gate counts remain charged.

Upper theorems hold for all admitted parameters. Matching lower bounds are worst-case over the named frame family. Keep literal dirty reservations and precision ranges; one-clean count optimality supplies no extra depth theorem or matching transition between its base and doubled-base reservations.

## Current versus selected claims

- A: exact all-workspace size, CNOT-count and total-depth frontier.
- B: matching T-count with a sufficient clean allocation, not a necessary clean-space bound.
- C: precision-uniform one-clean count and the banked frontier. [Growing-source Sections 11–12](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/research/endpoint/GROWING_SOURCE_COMPILER.md#11-precision-uniform-one-clean-count) are authoritative; retained two-clean corollaries keep distinct allocations.
- Selected D: [R79, uniform subtree depth](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/research/depth/UNIFORM_SUBTREE_DEPTH.md), with R78 decoder and R72 terminal/fallback dependencies.
- Strongest unconditional research upper: [R96, all-precision linear depth](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/research/depth/ALL_PRECISION_LINEAR_DEPTH.md), preserving one clean qubit, the real/complex dirty thresholds, optimal T-count and complete return error. R79 remains selected D.
- Optimal general T-depth remains open. A source-specific obstruction, logical-call lower bound or smaller component constant is not an unrestricted depth bound or a complete-circuit improvement. Read WORKSPACE for the current unpaid native operation and active physical-pair scout.

## Separate evidence and task boundaries

The [state-based QBP supplement](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GoGoKo699/Hopf-Frame-Compilation/main/supplements/state_based_qbp/README.md) changes the decoder and has a separate task-level guarantee. The fixed-decoder QBP consequences separately price executions, observable access and classical output; they claim no optimality among all gradient algorithms or end-to-end training advantage.

Finite checks support named identities, phases, inverses, work return and ledgers. They do not prove universal asymptotic claims. Internal audits are not external peer review or formal proof certification; no general native emitter is claimed.

Preserve one proof home per claim, stable identifiers and inbound anchors. Front pages route; they do not accumulate session histories. Keep useful component proofs and scoped failed attempts when a stronger headline supersedes their old benchmark.

Use the exact consulted commit and CITATION.cff for attribution. MIT licensed. Contact: gogoko699@gmail.com.
